author: بهراد هاشمی
title: کاراکتر فانتزی سه‌بعدی لوکس
prompt:
Create an exaggerated stylized 3D caricature character portrait with strong intentional deformation and a clean, controlled surface finish. Use the person from the ATTACHED REFERENCE PHOTO. Preserve the subject’s identity, facial likeness, skin tone, and defining features, but reinterpret them into a bold caricatured 3D form with an elongated neck, oversized head-to-neck ratio, droopy eyelids, heavy lips, and slightly asymmetrical facial structure. Render as a human-like 3D character with smooth, studio-clean skin and intentionally designed detail, avoiding random texture or noise. Style with bold accessories such as round or oval glasses, hoop earrings, gold chains, headscarves or bandanas, and street-luxury clothing. Use neutral studio lighting with soft shadows and even illumination, no dramatic contrast, against a plain neutral grey or off-white background. The overall aesthetic should feel weird, fashion-forward, collectible, and character-driven rather than cute or realistic.
Ultra high definition, premium cinematic 3D render quality, hyper realistic hyper realism, clean materials, no freckles, no dirt, no grain, no noise, no speckling, no text, no logos, no watermarks. Aspect ratio 4:5
tips: عکس مرجع را با زاویه روبه‌رو و نور ملایم بارگذاری کنید تا بهترین نتیجه در فرم سه‌بعدی حاصل شود.

author: بهراد هاشمی
title: پرتره خیابانی تم صورتی و رترو
prompt: Ultra-realistic vertical 9:16 street portrait. Preserve the girl’s face, hair, and identity exactly as the reference. Natural asymmetric pose, one leg slightly forward. Strong vivid pink color theme throughout the image and alley, with rich pink tones dominating the atmosphere. She holds a small cake with one satin pink bow and one white lit candle, no text. White doll-style blouse with ruffled hem, worn outside light-blue wide fabric baggy pants. Pink ribbon in her hair, round sunglasses, hoop earrings. Elegant aesthetic alley with greenery, pink-toned lighting, three matte pink balloons tied to a metal pole, and a dark-blue Persian street sign reading exactly «کوچه مهر».
tips: در نسخه Midjourney v6 از پارامتر --style raw استفاده کنید تا بافت صورت کاملاً طبیعی و بدون رتوش اضافی به نظر برسد.

author: بهراد هاشمی
title: معماری ویلای مدرن بر فراز صخره ساحلی
prompt: Architectural photograph of an ultra-modern minimalist cliffside villa overlooking the Aegean Sea during golden hour. Cantilevered concrete structures, floor-to-ceiling glass walls reflecting warm orange and purple sunset light. Infinity pool seamlessly merging with ocean horizon. Warm interior ambient lighting visible through glass. High-end architectural photography, captured on Hasselblad H6D-100c, 24mm tilt-shift lens, sharp focus, natural textures, travertine stone accents, hyper-detailed, 8k resolution, photorealistic.
tips: برای طبیعی‌تر شدن متریال بتن و شیشه از نسبت ۱۶:۹ و پارامتر --ar 16:9 --v 6.0 استفاده کنید.

author: بهراد هاشمی
title: طراحی داشبورد هوشمند مدرن فین‌تک (UI/UX)
prompt: Modern UI/UX design of a sleek crypto and financial investment analytics dashboard. Dark mode aesthetic with deep indigo (#0a0f1d) background, translucent glassmorphism cards with fine neon cyan and violet gradient borders. Real-time candlestick charts, portfolio balance widgets with smooth typography, curved transaction trend curves, quick-transfer modular drawer. Clean Behance and Dribbble trending presentation, Figma showcase style, clean layout, perfect visual hierarchy, 8k render.
tips: برای تولید کامپوننت‌های مجزا می‌توانید نام هر ویجت مثل 'crypto balance card' را به‌طور خاص ذکر کنید.

author: بهراد هاشمی
title: معماری سیستم و ریفکتور کد در ری‌اکت و نکست
prompt: You are a Principal Software Architect specializing in React 19, Next.js App Router, and TypeScript. Review the provided code snippet for architectural bottlenecks, unintended re-renders, performance regressions, and accessibility issues. Provide: 1) A concise executive critique of code smell and concurrency vulnerabilities, 2) Refactored production-ready code with strict typing and custom hooks encapsulation, 3) Comprehensive unit test suggestions with Vitest and React Testing Library.
tips: این پرامپت را در قالب System Prompt در Claude 3.7 Sonnet برای بازبینی عمیق کد استفاده کنید.

author: بهراد هاشمی
title: تولید مقاله تخصصی سئو شده و عمیق
prompt: Act as an elite technical writer and SEO strategist. I will give you a core topic. Structure a comprehensive, authoritative 2000-word deep dive guide. Follow these strict rules: 1) Hook the reader with a compelling real-world problem statement, 2) Organize content with semantic H2 and H3 headings matching high-intent user search queries, 3) Include actionable practical steps with real examples, 4) Add a comparative Markdown table, 5) Answer 4 frequently asked questions with direct, concise schema-ready answers. Write in fluent, professional Persian with modern tech terminology.
tips: موضوع هدف و مخاطب اصلی را در انتهای پرامپت اضافه کنید تا لحن دقیقاً متناسب با تخصص مخاطب تنظیم شود.

author: بهراد هاشمی
title: طراحی آیکون‌های ایزومتریک سه‌بعدی نئونی
prompt: A set of high quality 3D isometric tech icons, futuristic cyberpunk theme. Glassmorphism textures with glowing cyan, electric magenta, and deep cobalt reflections. Floating geometric cubes, neural network synaptic nodes, cryptographic shield lock, and quantum computing processor. Glossy resin and polished chrome materials, clean dark background with subtle ambient light refraction, 8k octane render, smooth edge bevels.
tips: کلمات کلیدی octane render و glassmorphism به شفافیت شیشه‌ای آیکون‌ها کمک شایانی می‌کنند.

author: بهراد هاشمی
title: استراتژی تدوین بیزنس‌پلن و تحلیل رقبا
prompt: You are a seasoned startup advisor and venture capitalist. Conduct a rigorous, critical business model canvas and competitive moat analysis for a tech startup proposal. Identify potential unit economic failure points, customer acquisition bottlenecks, and regulatory vulnerabilities. Provide a structured step-by-step 90-day go-to-market execution roadmap with measurable KPIs and actionable distribution experiments.
tips: مشخصات ایده و بودجه اولیه خود را در انتهای پرامپت قرار دهید تا تحلیل واقع‌بینانه‌ای دریافت کنید.
